title: ProtoBridge-CLIP: Observation-Masked Finding Prototypes for Medical Image--Report Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.24002v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Radiology reports distinguish affirmed findings, explicit negations, and unmentioned concepts, but conventional global image--report contrastive learning often compresses these different evidence states into a single study-level target. We introduce \model{}, which combines symmetric global image--report alignment with observation-masked finding supervision and a soft relation objective over affirmed report concepts. Text-derived finding prototypes are aligned with local visual tokens, while uncertain and unmentioned concepts are excluded from direct finding labels. We evaluate the framework on three CT benchmarks and five chest-radiograph benchmarks, together with component ablations, paired and clinical retrieval, localization, perturbation robustness, calibration, and per-finding analyses. \model{} achieves macro-AUROC values of 73.6%, 66.5\%, and 68.8% on CT-RATE, RAD-ChestCT, and INSPECT, and 80.2%, 91.4%, 78.5%, 86.5%, and 90.8%

translated_title: ProtoBridge-CLIP：基于观察掩蔽的影像学征象原型用于医学图像-报告表征学习
translated_abstract: 放射学报告区分了确认的征象、明确的否定以及未提及的概念，但传统的全局图像-报告对比学习往往将这些不同的证据状态压缩为单一的研究级别目标。我们提出了 ProtoBridge-CLIP，它将对称的全局图像-报告对齐与观察掩蔽的征象监督以及对报告中被确认概念的软关系目标相结合。从文本中提取的征象原型与局部视觉 token 进行对齐，同时不确定和未提及的概念被排除在直接的征象标签之外。我们在三个 CT 基准和五个胸片基准上评估了该框架，并进行了组件消融实验、配对和临床检索、定位、扰动鲁棒性、校准以及逐征象分析。ProtoBridge-CLIP 在 CT-RATE、RAD-ChestCT 和 INSPECT 上分别取得了 73.6%、66.5% 和 68.8% 的宏平均 AUROC，并在五个胸片基准上取得了 80.2%、91.4%、78.5%、86.5% 和 90.8% 的成绩。
tldr: 提出 ProtoBridge-CLIP，通过对称全局图文对齐、观察掩蔽的征象监督以及文本征象原型与局部视觉 token 的对齐，在医学图像-报告表征学习中有效区分确认、否定与未提及的证据状态，并在多个 CT 和胸片基准上取得优异表现。
